name: 34733-shortchurn-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, served in-process through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend. No router, no external cache tier, no second node.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 256, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 65536 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, static seed 34733.
workload: single-turn synthetic text: 64 prompt tokens and 32 output tokens, each pinned min == max, greedy (temperature 0.0) with `ignore_eos` so length cannot drift. The backend applies the checkpoint's chat template, so a 64-token body is ~74 tokens on the wire. Every prompt is distinct.
purpose: A compact Llama chat assistant giving brief replies to 256 concurrent users from short prompts on one GPU.
launch:
model: unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 131072
max-num-seqs: 512
attention-backend: FLASHINFER
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
